label: Snowflake
description: Long-format metric_daily table queried through snowsql. Replace the connection and fully qualified table; keep the password in the snowsql profile, not this file.

config.sql: SELECT metric_key, metric_date, value, source, computed_at FROM YOUR_DATABASE.YOUR_SCHEMA.METRIC_DAILY WHERE metric_date BETWEEN DATE '{{start}}' AND DATE '{{end}}' ORDER BY metric_key, metric_date
